title: Most Alike Pair
statement:
Two numbers are "alike" when their bitwise XOR is small. Among all pairs of positions `i < j`, find the smallest value of `a_i XOR a_j`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the smallest XOR of a pair.

## Constraints
- `2 <= n <= 16000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
